Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human histone deacetylase 6. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by target organism Homo sapiens and target name histone deacetylase 6. Alias the molecule identifier column as compound_chembl_id. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
